purpose: Keep the living topic list growing: read-only web research for fields where doing the job with AI is a good skill, scored 0-10 for the channel, good finds (5+) added as ideas through topics.py.

model.notes: web search and scoring need a model; run by a research agent with read-only tools (Read, Grep, Glob, Bash, WebSearch, WebFetch). The chat note to the owner is sent by the main session, not the agent.

owner_approval: scheduling a weekly task (the owner sets it up)
evaluation: topics.py due exits 0 after 7 days or never, else 1; a --dry-run research run prints candidates (URLs, score, why, verified) and leaves the topic files and state file unchanged; a real run adds only score 5+ finds, never a duplicate, then render and mark-run.

provenance.license: unspecified (the repo owner picks one before publishing)

portability: topics.py is Python stdlib only; the research step needs any model with web search.
